reports.title: LTC REPORTS 2026 THIRD QUARTER RESULTS AS SHOP MOMENTUM CONTINUES

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: LTC is increasing its 2026 SHOP investment mid-point guidance to $1 billion from $900 million. Additionally, LTC is narrowing its 2026 SHOP NOI guidance to a range of $73.5 million to $76.4 million, from $71.2 million to $79.9 million. LTC reaffirmed its 2026 full-year total Company guidance as follows:
